svg.title: India Healthcare Provider Preference Chart
svg.text: A slice of life in numbers
India's sick visit quacks and chemists.
They dream of a real hospital.
If people got their preferred provider, govt hospitals would gain 3,402 patients.
+3,402 patients would move to Govt Hospitals
Net change = stated preferred next visit minus actual last visit · Outpatient respondents n = 41,825
Source: Citizen Survey 2022–23 · Lancet Citizens' Commission on Reimagining India's Health System
